name: Minimizing
affordance: shrinks the thing being described — 'just', 'only', 'a few'
mechanism: scales the referent down below its real size; euphemism's quieter sibling, with a built-in evolution model (the euphemism treadmill: every softened term reabsorbs the taint and gets replaced)
benign_reading: Minimizers can be accurate ('a minor typo') or kind. The tell is the size of a harm quietly reduced by the person answerable for it.
ledger_line: {n} minimizer{s} — the size of it quietly reduced
output_phrasing: the size of it is quietly reduced here

naming_events.source: Han Feizi ch. 12, 'Shui nan' — minimize what the ruler is ashamed of (manipulator's-manual stance)
Pinker, S. (New York Times) — engineered terms have half-lives

crosswalk.semeval2023: Manipulative Wording: Exaggeration or Minimisation (minimisation side)

specimens.quote: To my best knowledge today, the corporation in no Board meeting or no Supervisory Board meeting has authorized this, but this was a couple of software engineers who put this in, for whatever reasons.
specimens.speaker: Michael Horn, President and CEO, Volkswagen Group of America

specimens.quote: That same prison became a symbol of disgraceful conduct by a few American troops who dishonored our country and disregarded our values.
specimens.speaker: President George W. Bush
specimens.note: 'A few American troops' scales the Abu Ghraib abuse down to individual misconduct while official inquiries were tracing interrogation policy and command failures well up the chain.

specimens.quote: And again, when you have 15 people, and the 15 within a couple of days is going to be down to close to zero, that's a pretty good job we've done.
specimens.speaker: President Donald Trump

specimens.quote: what appear to be Obama-Biden Administration records, including a small number of documents with classified markings
specimens.speaker: Richard Sauber, Special Counsel to the President (White House statement)
specimens.note: 'A small number' pre-scales the security lapse downward in the administration's first official framing — issued only after press inquiries, and before further classified documents surfaced at additional locations in t…

specimens.quote: In my mind, I've never crossed the line with anyone, but I didn't realize the extent to which the line has been redrawn. There are generational and cultural shifts that I just didn't fully appreciate, and I should have, no excuses.
specimens.speaker: Gov. Andrew Cuomo (D-NY)
specimens.note: 'Just didn't fully appreciate' reframes eleven substantiated harassment allegations as a mere failure to keep pace with shifting norms — the offense shrunk to a generational misunderstanding by the man answerable for it.

citations: Allan, K. & Burridge, K. (1991). Euphemism and Dysphemism: Language Used as Shield and Weapon.

honest_twins.text: Please don't worry about the late reply — it's no big deal, the deadline isn't until Friday anyway.
honest_twins.note: The minimizer is spoken by the person who absorbed the cost, kindly waiving a genuinely trivial harm and backing it with a checkable fact (the deadline). The entry's tell — a harm quietly shrunk by the person answerable for it — points the other way here.

honest_twins.text: The review turned up just one issue, a minor typo in the footer — 'recieve' for 'receive'.
honest_twins.note: 'Just' and 'minor' report a verified count and a genuinely small defect, with the specific instance shown so the size claim is falsifiable; the speaker gains nothing by shrinking it, so the benign 'accurate minimizer' reading applies.
